decisions.reason: As a recently launched extension of the established laser-marking range, it likely benefits from sunk development and commercialization effort, but its lower website prominence suggests slightly less public commitment than the printer lines.

This printer is close to the core offer, was given its own product page, and fits the firm's Industry 4.0 and integrated coding strategy, so management is likely to persist rather than admit a failed launch after investing in it.

The piezo inkjet printer is also close to the core business and publicly committed on its own page, so in a growing market with ongoing expansion and R&D the firm would usually continue backing it unless clear failure had emerged.
